verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an HR and payroll platform like Justworks, but the evidence pack shows no user-configurable recurring schedules. The closest items are adjacent automatic behaviors: holidays carry over each year, and invoices can sync to Xero the day after processing. Neither is a user-defined recurring job or workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
